segments.title: Broadcast Open & Sponsor Read
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, reads Heart Audio Cables sponsor copy, and checks in on Chet Manscape in the wasteland.

segments.title: Fallout 4 Wasteland Gameplay
segments.notes: Chet Manscape commandeers the broadcast for an extended Fallout 4 session, building settlements, fighting mutants, and roleplaying as an overpowered wasteland general.

segments.title: Broadcast Close & Raid
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns to close the broadcast, thanks viewers, and raids Genie Darling.

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell opened the broadcast with a sponsor read before handing control to Chief Science Correspondent Chet Manscape, who commandeered the studio for a feature-length Fallout 4 session. Chet roleplayed an overpowered wasteland general, constructing settlements, decimating super mutants and crabs, and flirting with irradiated NPCs. Blackwell returned to close the hour and raid Genie Darling.
